hook.line: On-screen text only: 'I asked Chat GPT...' (no voice; a pop song plays).
hook.visual: Black slide with small handwritten-style white text 'I asked Chat GPT....' mid-frame and three carousel dots below; photo-mode slideshow.

beats.what: Slide 1: black screen, 'I asked Chat GPT....' as the setup
Slide 2: the prompt as a stacked list: how do you see me as a colour, feeling, song, weather, season, scent, flower, food
Slide 3: ChatGPT's answer as a moody autumn collage grid of nine labelled tiles around a portrait, 'this is me'
Collage held on screen until the loop while the song plays

why_it_works: Three-step reveal (I asked, the prompt, the result) makes viewers wait for the payoff image
The prompt is shown in full, so viewers can copy it and try it themselves: a participatory trend
Dense collage invites pausing and rewatching to read every tile, which lifts watch time and loops
Personal and aesthetic topic travels far beyond AI audiences (560k plays)
weaknesses: Nearly 10 s of plain black text slides before anything visual
Collage text tiles are too small to read without pausing
No creator voice or face, so nothing builds a following
for_robert: Steal the 'I asked ChatGPT... here is the prompt... here is the result' three-step reveal, but show the result in under 3 s; Fred could hold up the prompt card.
